NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair: Gaming
NewsArticle.Content: .01.09 Dartanian Lestor, Aisling and longstanding organizer in Mileth, writes of the first Aisling-hosted fair, hosted by Mileth Village: Mileth Festival: Registration and Sign-ups - Gaming Gaming (a.k.a. gambling)- Contact Diamanda for any questions and/or interest in any of these events. These events are pretty much to be chosen by the dealer (interviewed by the contact first). There are 5 tables at any time to be filled and each aisling signs up for 8 Temuairan hour shifts at a time. An aisling can sign up for multiple shifts if they wish. It is recommended that any involved in gaming make certain they trust the dealer. Gaming is held at your own risk. We try to keep it safe but there are no guarentees. A few suggestions on games: Fiosachd's Dice, Skull Monty, Card games, etc. Again, see Diamanda for details.
